<div class="card-body">
'''Cell 2187''' is a [[Light]] [[Effect]] ([[Utinni Effect]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊2187番独房</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">「ドッキング・ベイ327」を除いた任意のデス・スターの位置カードに配備する。デス・スターにいる自分のスパイかリーダーを1名、目標として選ぶ。目標がウーティーニ・エフェクトに到達したら運命数を引く。その数に等しい人数の捕虜を「監房ブロック通路」から脱出させる。ウーティーニ・エフェクトはロストされる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Cell-2187-SWCA-12640.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">「あなた、ストームトルーパーにしちゃ背が低いわね」</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Cell 2187.

'''Card text:'''
Deploy on any Death Star location card except Docking Bay 327. Target one of your spies or leaders who is on the Death Star. When the target reaches the Utinni Effect, draw destiny. Release that many captives from Detention Block Corridor. The Utinni Effect is lost.

'''Lore:'''
“Aren't you a little short for a stormtrooper?”

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese targets a spy or leader on the Death Star; the English targets one not on the Death Star.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Cell 2187]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
